card.name: Words just before the drug name Insulin
card.fires_on: The word right before a capitalized "Insulin" drug name (Aspart, Degludec, Glargine) in insulin labels. Usually a verb such as mix, remove, transfer, start, or the word "of".

modes.label: Handling verbs
modes.description: Verbs about mixing, diluting, or moving insulin, just before the insulin name.
modes.example: Do not<< mix>> Insulin Aspart with any other insulin

modes.label: "of" before the name
modes.description: The word "of" after a unit count, dose, or time course, leading into the insulin name.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose<< of>> Insulin Degludec in insulin naï
